name: strength-barbell-complex
description: Gorillot weightlifting complex 'Every 01:15 x 10 sets: 1 Power Clean + 1 Hang Power Clean, build to heavy'. Guards the complex-collapse: a '+'-joined same-bar complex (exercise.complex=true) renders as ONE combined poster line ('1 Power Clean + 1 Hang Power Clean'), NOT two standalone movement rows that read like separate lifts. The shared weight progression rides on the single line.
